verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers an MCP server that lets AI agents query and act on financial data (spend, cards, reimbursements), but there is no evidence of the product itself generating AI-driven insights, suggestions, or analysis from user data within the product experience — it's action/query tooling, not insight generation. missing for 10: any documentation of AI-generated insights, anomaly detection, spend recommendations, or proactive suggestions surfaced inside Jeeves.
